comments_data.body:
Thanks for this @lebaphi 

When I'm playing with data, it's really convenient to be able to test things from a story - since it's so quick/easy to modify the mock data, or to use StoryBook controls.

It would be good if `SupportPanel` and `SupportMapping` were in the same story. Is it possible to switch `PlanningChannel` to be a `Component` like in our `packages\components` package?
Aah, one more issue.  With any of the `SupportPanel` expanded, the map doesn't respond to drag/zoom.  With the SupportPanel collapsed, it is possible to drag/zoom

I'm going to do some refactoring @lebaphi, to remove `state`.  This is the only component in `packages/components` that uses `PlayerUI`.   I know it will mean a _lot_ more props, but it's will be easier to generate the test data when I just need to think about the data that's required.

issues.title: Introduce LeafletJS map in background of Support Panel
issues.body:
Now that we've got assets in the Support Panel, and we're letting users filter them, we should start displaying them on a map.

The map will replace the static image.  It will use the `leaflet` map that we already for the `mapping` channel.  See the `mapping` component.  We won't be re-using the `mapping` component, because it contains lots of complexity - and we don't need all that functionality for `SupportPanel`.  But, `mapping` may be useful for seeing how it is done.

Once we have the `SupportMapping` component working, I'll create other issues, to let us put arrays of Assets onto it. `SupportPanel` will pass these asset arrays in response to `ownForces` and `opForces` state objects.

But, for this issue, we will just be creating the `SupportMapping` component, which will have a toolbar with zoom in & zoom out.
